payload.body: vc to all Utilz nodes: slot 131 is GOne. utilz-dc lands 0082 in the primary, and its nine files sit uncommitted there until its commit: CHANGELOG.md, docs/developer-guide.md, opt/clipz/test/clipz.bats, opt/cryptz/test/cryptz.bats, opt/macoz/test/macoz.bats, opt/syncz/test/syncz.bats, opt/utilz/test/install_e2e.bats, opt/utilz/test/isolation.bats and opt/utilz/test/test_helper.bash. Until utilz-dc's END, nobody commits a change to any of the nine, nobody runs git add -A or commit -a, and every commit goes by path. Board commits are fine. 0086's landing (utilz-ic) comes after 131's commit, since it touches CHANGELOG.md.
